“I stopped smiling with my mouth open in photos.”
It starts small. The hand that comes up in pictures, choosing the tighter-lipped smile. Then one day you realize you've been editing yourself out of your own photos.
“For the first time, I could see the result before we started.”
Photos, a full evaluation of your teeth and bite, and virtual smile design that maps how your teeth, lips, and face work together, so your plan is built around your features, not a catalog.
“I wore my new smile before anything was permanent.”

You approve the digital design before any preparation begins, and temporaries let you live with the new shape and proportions in real lighting while your porcelain is crafted. If something needs adjusting, it happens now.
“It looks like my smile, just the version I always wanted.”
Custom porcelain, shaded and checked under natural lighting to match your natural teeth. Dr. Sung's standard is a result that enhances your smile without announcing that you had work done.
Your smile is planned around your lips, facial proportions, skin tone, and the way your teeth show when you speak, proportions and shapes built from your features, not a template.
Your bite, jaw function, tooth health, and gums are evaluated first. Beautiful work should feel comfortable and hold up over time.
Dr. Sung evaluates, designs, explains your options, and places the final result. Whitening, veneers, bonding, Invisalign, smile makeovers, no referral out, no second office.
Whitening, bonding, alignment, and no-prep or minimal-prep options are considered before more involved treatment. When veneers are the answer, enamel removal is typically under a millimeter.

Your consultation determines which path fits your teeth, bite, goals, timeline, and budget. Here's the landscape before you walk in.
Brighten natural teeth with professional KöR® whitening, repair small chips, close select gaps, and refine uneven edges while preserving healthy tooth structure.
Bonding is usually completed chair-side in a single visit. KöR® whitening depends on how deep the staining is and whether you combine it with other treatment.

Shouldn't Look & Feel Like Dental Work

Beautiful cosmetic dentistry is more than choosing a lighter shade. Grand Mission considers tooth shape, texture, translucency, facial balance, gum health, and bite before permanent treatment begins. You approve your design first. Nothing permanent happens until you do. then shows you the direction

A full evaluation of your smile, bite, and goals, plus a digital simulation of your potential result, so you see where this is going before anything begins. You can even start by uploading photos from home.

Whether it's whitening, minimal-prep veneers, or a full makeover, Dr. Sung removes only what's necessary, typically less than a millimeter of enamel. Temporaries let you live with the new shape while your porcelain is made.
Custom porcelain or refined bonding, tried in and checked under natural lighting against your approved design, then permanently bonded. What you approved is what you get.
Every smile below started with a conversation, a full examination, and a plan built around that specific patient. No shortcuts. No assumptions.

From the moment you walk in, Grand Mission feels different. Calm, modern, and built with patients in mind, because your experience starts before you sit in the chair. Our team speaks English, Spanish, Vietnamese, Korean, and Arabic.

Cosmetic dentistry can address stains, chips, worn or uneven edges, small gaps, tooth shape, asymmetry, old dental work, and the overall balance of your smile. Your plan may include whitening, bonding, veneers, crowns, gum recontouring, Invisalign, or a thoughtful combination.
How do I know whether I need veneers or bonding?

Bonding is often a conservative choice for smaller chips, gaps, or shape changes, and can usually be completed in a single visit. Veneers are typically considered when several teeth need a more comprehensive change in color, shape, size, or symmetry, and they last considerably longer. Dr. Sung will explain the tradeoffs after evaluating your teeth, bite, and goals.

That is the goal. Your design is based on your facial proportions, lips, natural tooth characteristics, and preferred level of brightness. Porcelain is chosen for the way it mimics the translucency of natural enamel, and shade is matched under natural lighting, so the result looks like it belongs to you, not like a generic set of teeth.
Can I preview the result before treatment?

Yes. Virtual smile design lets you see your potential result before treatment begins; you can even start by uploading photos from home. You approve the design before any tooth preparation, and temporaries let you experience the shape and proportions while your final restorations are crafted.
How long does cosmetic treatment take?

It depends on your starting point. Bonding and whitening can often be completed quickly, porcelain veneers typically take two visits, and a comprehensive makeover involving alignment or restorative work may take several. You will receive a clear sequence and timeline before deciding to begin.
How much does cosmetic dentistry cost?

It depends on the number of teeth involved, the procedures selected, and the materials used. Porcelain veneers generally range from $900 to $2,000 per tooth, so a six-veneer makeover typically falls between $5,400 and $12,000. After your evaluation you will get a clear written estimate before you decide, and financing through Cherry, including 0% APR options, is available.
Is cosmetic dentistry covered by insurance?

Procedures done purely for appearance are generally not covered. When treatment also restores a damaged or unhealthy tooth, insurance may cover part of the cost. Our team verifies your benefits and walks you through your options so you know your out-of-pocket cost before you commit to anything.
Stop Postponing The Smile You Actually Want
The right time to feel good about your smile is always sooner than you think. Find out exactly what's possible with a consultation and a digital smile preview.
